item.title: Phillies to watch at spring training while the WBC raids their roster
item.description: With several of the Phillies' best players away for about two weeks, those who are staying in Clearwater will see more playing time – and deserve your attention.

item.title: Barnes Foundation First Friday will mix live jazz, cocktails and after-hours gallery access
item.description: The Barnes Foundation will stay open late on Friday, March 6 for its monthly First Friday event, which blends live music with access to the museum’s galleries.

item.title: Americans trust the CDC less under Donald Trump than they did under Joe Biden, Penn survey shows
item.description: Americans have less trust in the CDC under Donald Trump than they did under Joe Biden, pollsters at the University of Pennsylvania have found. Americans also express more confidence in career scientists and medical groups than federal health officials.

item.title: Large section of Willow Grove Park Mall listed for sale in Montgomery County
item.description: A large portion of the Willow Grove Park Mall, long owned by PREIT, will be sold by the firm's lender after a $170 million loan reached maturity. The mall in Montgomery County is one the region's top-performing shopping destinations.

item.title: American Swedish Historical Museum to host Easter Family Day
item.description: An Easter celebration at the American Swedish Historical Museum will give families a chance to explore how the holiday is celebrated in Sweden.

item.title: Trader Joe's recalls 4 frozen food products due to possible glass contamination
item.description: Trader Joe's recalled four frozen food products due to possible glass contamination. The recall includes Chicken Shu Mai and three varieties of fried rice — chicken, vegetable and Japanese style.

item.title: Neshaminy Creek Brewing will host a Phillies Opening Day watch party in Croydon
item.description: Phillies fans looking for a place to watch the team’s season opener can head to Neshaminy Creek Brewing Company, which is hosting an Opening Day watch party on Thursday, March 26.

item.title: Watch Party PHL finds space on Broad Street for community hub centered on women's sports
item.description: The founders of Watch Party PHL, a group of women's sports fans, found a space on Broad Street to open the Stoop Pigeon — a cafe, bar and co-working space centered around women's sports.

item.title: Pa., N.J. join multi-state lawsuit against tariffs Trump imposed after Supreme Court ruling
item.description: A coalition of 24 state attorneys general and governors, including Pennsylvania's Josh Shapiro, have sued President Donald Trump over his latest wave of tariffs. The Supreme Court struck down his previous taxes in February.

item.title: Council members urge Philly school district to 'go back to the drawing board' on facilities plan
item.description: Members of City Council on Thursday criticized the School District of Philadelphia 's proposal to close 18 schools. One elected official vowed to revisit a measure that would allow City Council to impeach Board of Education members.
